files.jail.local:
[DEFAULT]
banaction = iptables-allports
ignoreip = 127.0.0.1/8
[apache-noscript]
enabled = true
backend = auto
maxretry = x
bantime = 10m
action = %(action_mwl)s
[postfix]
enabled = true
maxretry = x
action = %(action_mwl)s
ignoreip = example.com
[groupoffice]
enabled = true
action = %(action_mw)s
port = http,https
usedns = raw
